blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY — Police officers from Taguig City rescued on Sunday eight-month-old twin boys who were sold for P71,000 to a couple in the Pampanga town of Candaba. The mother of the twins sold her babies for P30,000 sometime last August to a woman who was supposed to adopt them as her own children, Police Captain Ibralen D.A. Jain, chief of Taguig City police’s Women and Children Protection Desk, told the Inquirer in a phone interview on Monday. Jain said the person supposedly adopting the children was actually a “middle person” or broker who resold the twins to a live-in couple […]...
